claims.claim: The GBI FY2002 administration report says the GBI partnered with broadcasters and emergency management in January 2002 to establish Georgia’s abducted-child alert, named Levi’s Call, and credits its Public Affairs Office with research and development.
claims.assessment_rationale: Direct agency account of its own program history; high confidence in attribution, not blanket verification of case assertions. Human verification pending.
claims.notes: BATCH-RESEARCH-20261023-001; month precision only; no day/time, first-use date or individual alert activation inferred.
